From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-15T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps from today — pilot scope & timeline

Hi Eva,

Great conversation today — thanks for walking us through Finvia's ingestion patterns and the latency targets you mentioned. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Pilot scope: 1 production dataset (payments), 2 models for A/B (embedding + gpt-like for enrichment)
- Success criteria: 99th p95 latency < 350ms for typical requests + accuracy threshold from your QA set
- Data/infosec ask: SOC2 evidence + encryption in transit at rest confirmation
- Timeline: target pilot kickoff the week of Nov 29; integration work ~2 weeks

Requested items from your side:
1) Procurement contact & preferred PO cadence (you mentioned a procurement mailbox)
2) Counsel contact for reviewing our standard MSA (we can send a tracked PDF)
3) Any internal eval datasets we should prioritize for the initial run

I'll push a short mutual action plan to the Drive and share the SOW draft. Marcus will follow up on the integration checklist. If this looks right, can you confirm priority (high/medium/low) and whether Nov 29 works for the kickoff?

Thanks,
Aisha

Gina — really appreciate the quick turn. We received the redlines and have reviewed internally. Two quick items Marcus wanted to flag for counsel: 

1) Liability cap: Redwood proposes a mutual cap equal to 1x the first 12 months' fees for the pilot.
2) Data residency: we can agree to contractual commitments for transit and rest; can you confirm whether Finvia requires specific cloud-region binding in the MSA?

Marcus, Laura — fyi we should prepare a short note that explains the rationale behind the 1x cap and how our Dedicated option can be used if they require stricter isolation.

Eva — will you be able to route the revised file to procurement once Gina confirms the region ask? We want to avoid blocking the Nov 29 kickoff if possible.

Best,
Aisha
